name: Character Model
title: Attributes, skills, and derived statistics
summary: 07.1 defines seven attributes, independent skills, and checks; 07.2 defines derived values. Item Creation skill primarily determines modifier-count probability, with Luck and Perception added. Exact progression and coefficients remain open.
scenarioNote: No full player/NPC development scenario was audited.

points.text: No global character level; attributes and skills progress independently through relevant actions.
Seven attributes and the base success curve are owner-approved; remaining mappings/coefficient values are open.
Strength primarily contributes to Carrying Capacity; exact weight/capacity formula remains open.
Item Creation skill plus Luck and Perception affect modifier-count probability, not fixed base type weights.

gaps: Full skill catalogue, action mappings, growth values, carry-capacity formula, and modifier-count curve.
